# Source provenance

This is a self-contained snapshot of `nate-santos/flutter_adb` based on
`58ce3167a9d4f217f46e034b0a56402e7640d50d`, with the repair from local commit
`28995a196ba5f098141807ea76af7cfe16a31985` on `fix/negotiated-adb-writes`.

The package's source, license, regression tests, and emulator smoke test are
retained. `REPAIR_NOTES.md` describes the changes. OpenPelo references this
snapshot through a relative path so a fresh checkout builds without an
unpublished Git dependency revision.
